verdict.rationale: Unleash Edge (open source) and Unleash Enterprise Edge are documented as a lightweight caching/relay layer that sits between SDKs and the Unleash server, acting as a read replica that can serve thousands of SDKs and improve resilience — keeping SDK traffic local and flags served even if the vendor/backend is unreachable. Self-hosting via Docker is also documented, reinforcing the on-network deployment model. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Edge's offline-resilience behavior and more detail on failover semantics beyond docs claims.
